title: Enter the Keep
text: The Ashen Bell has rung for thirteen nights. Rowan Vey leads the other two into Nocturne Keep, where every stone is black with old vows.

title: Explore the Chapel Crypt
text: Selene finds a silver map beneath the altar. It points through the chapel floor to a crypt full of moon-starved things—and the stair to the bell tower.

title: Confront the Ashen Bell
text: The bellkeeper lifts a scythe made from the rope's shadow. Break his vigil, and dawn may find the keep silent.
